## agent-ml-research
ML research experiment management tools

attachment.content:
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

content.content: {"result":"{\"success\": true, \"data\": {\"path\": \"/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-prod43/projects/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/memory.md\", \"content\": \"# Memory — gated_mfrm_judge_bias\\n\\n## MVP 验证链 (2026-05-21)\\n\\n### mvp_001: 信号太弱 → FAIL\\nc~HalfNormal(0.5), sigmoid(e), N=20, J=5。joint vs sequential Δ=0.0008, p=0.39。contamination 项仅占 logit ~10-15%。\\n\\n### mvp_002: 方法有效但 MCMC 不收敛 → FAIL (技术性)\\nc~HalfNormal(1.5), bimodal e, s~N(0,0.8), N=50, J=8, ρ=0.6。joint RMSE 降 32.8%, p=1e-6。但 ESS=47<100, R̂=1.05 边界。\\n\\n### mvp_003: MCMC 调优 → **PASS** ✅\\n同 mvp_002 DGP + warmup=2000, samples=4000, chains=4, target_accept=0.95, NCP for c。\\n- joint RMSE=0.1243±0.016 vs sequential=0.2211±0.038 → **降 43.8%, p=1e-6**\\n- joint τ=0.9223±0.010 vs sequential=0.8593±0.029 → +6.3pp\\n- R̂=1.03, ESS=224 → 收敛完全达标\\n\\n### 散点图确认 omitted variable bias\\nmvp_001 ρ=0.6: Pearson r=0.6534 (p≈0)。高 c_n 的 model 被 sequential 系统性高估 θ。\\n\\n### 关键经验\\n- contamination 信号需要足够强（c_scale≥1.5, bimodal e）才能暴露 sequential 的缺陷\\n- NCP + target_accept=0.95 对 HalfNormal 约束参数的 MCMC 收敛至关重要\\n- 4 chains 比 2 chains 在 ESS 上提升巨大（47→224），不只是线性翻倍\\n\\n## ConStat 调研 (2026-05-21)\\n\\n- **论文**: NeurIPS 2024, ETH Zurich SRI Lab. Repo: github.com/eth-sri/ConStat, Apache-2.0\\n- **接口**: `ConStat.test(...)` → p_value, delta, CI。纯黑盒，per-model 粒度。\\n- **⚠️ 关键 gap**: 不直接输出 per-item e_i。需推导或用 performance gap proxy。\\n\\n## Baseline 深度评估 (2026-05-22)\\n\\n### CyclicJudge ✅ 已实现\\n- 自实现 `/root/.../baselines/cyclic_judge.py` (58行)，round-robin + balanced(k=2) 两变体\\n\\n### DCR (EMNLP 2025) — contamination-only correction baseline\\n- **Repo**: github.com/chengxuphd/dcr, Apache-2.0, ~300行核心代码\\n- **接口**: `DCRCalculator.calculate_dcr(s1,s2,s3,s4)` → DCR Factor [0,1], 确定性计算无需训练\\n- **输入**: 4 层污染分数 (Semantic/Information/Data/Label)，需从 G-MFRM 数据推导\\n- **⚠️ 不能替代 e_i**: per-model×benchmark 粒度，无 item-level 分解\\n- **适配**: 0.5-1天，主要在 s1-s4 映射逻辑。风险：映射公平性可能被 reviewer 质疑\\n- **定位**: \\\"contamination-only correction\\\" 对照，证明不管 judge bias 不够\\n\\n### UDA (AAAI 2026) — unsupervised debiasing baseline\\n- **确认无代码**（anonymous repo 仍 403，作者 GitHub 无相关 repo）\\n- **方法**: MLP 动态调整 Elo K-factor + soft labels，最小化多 judge 间 dispersion\\n- **输入**: 多 judge pairwise judgments + response embeddings（6D+9 特征）\\n- **关键难点**: embedding 选择未明确、judge 自身 response 需额外生成、differentiable Elo\\n- **重实现**: ~330行, 2-3天。应在 exp-001 数据收集后开始（共用 pairwise judgment 数据）\\n- **定位**: aggregate-level debiasing 对照\\n\\n### Preference Leakage (ICLR 2026) — aggregate leakage detection baseline\\n- **Repo**: github.com/David-Li0406/Preference-Leakage, 无 license, 55 stars\\n- **核心**: PLS = judge 偏向其 student 的 win-rate 差异，aggregate-level 指标\\n- **⚠️ 无 per-item signal**: PLS 是 model-pair 级别聚合，无法分解到 item\\n- **重实现**: PLS 公式 ~20行, 总 1.5天。核心算法 trivial。\\n- **定位**: \\\"aggregate-level detection only\\\" 对照，G-MFRM 提供 per-item 粒度的优势\\n\\n### Baseline 总览\\n| Baseline | 代码 | 适配工作 | 定位 |\\n|----------|------|---------|------|\\n| CyclicJudge | ✅ 已完成 | 0 | naive round-robin |\\n| DCR | ✅ 可用 | 0.5-1天 | contamination-only |\\n| UDA | ❌ 需重实现 | 2-3天 | aggregate debiasing |\\n| Pref Leakage | ❌ 需重实现 | 1.5天 | aggregate detection |\\n\\n## exp-001 Judge API 调研 (2026-05-21)\\n\\n### Proprietary Judges (~$891 总费用)\\n| Judge | Model ID | 预估费用 |\\n|-------|----------|---------|\\n| GPT-4o | gpt-4o | $112.50 |\\n| GPT-5.5 | gpt-5.5 | $275.00 |\\n| Claude Opus 4.7 | claude-opus-4-7-20250219 | $250.00 |\\n| Claude Sonnet 4.6 | claude-sonnet-4-6-20250514 | $150.00 |\\n| Gemini 2.5 Pro | gemini-2.5-pro | $81.25 |\\n| DeepSeek V4 Pro | deepseek-v4-pro | $15.23 {"success": true, "data": {"path": "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-prod43/projects/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/memory.md", "content": "# Memory — gated_mfrm_judge_bias

## MVP 验证链 (2026-05-21)

### mvp_001: 信号太弱 → FAIL
c~HalfNormal(0.5), sigmoid(e), N=20, J=5。joint vs sequential Δ=0.0008, p=0.39。contamination 项仅占 logit ~10-15%。

### mvp_002: 方法有效但 MCMC 不收敛 → FAIL (技术性)
c~HalfNormal(1.5), bimodal e, s~N(0,0.8), N=50, J=8, ρ=0.6。joint RMSE 降 32.8%, p=1e-6。但 ESS=47<100, R̂=1.05 边界。

### mvp_003: MCMC 调优 → **PASS** ✅
同 mvp_002 DGP + warmup=2000, samples=4000, chains=4, target_accept=0.95, NCP for c。
- joint RMSE=0.1243±0.016 vs sequential=0.2211±0.038 → **降 43.8%, p=1e-6**
- joint τ=0.9223±0.010 vs sequential=0.8593±0.029 → +6.3pp
- R̂=1.03, ESS=224 → 收敛完全达标

### 散点图确认 omitted variable bias
mvp_001 ρ=0.6: Pearson r=0.6534 (p≈0)。高 c_n 的 model 被 sequential 系统性高估 θ。

### 关键经验
- contamination 信号需要足够强（c_scale≥1.5, bimodal e）才能暴露 sequential 的缺陷
- NCP + target_accept=0.95 对 HalfNormal 约束参数的 MCMC 收敛至关重要
- 4 chains 比 2 chains 在 ESS 上提升巨大（47→224），不只是线性翻倍

## ConStat 调研 (2026-05-21)

- **论文**: NeurIPS 2024, ETH Zurich SRI Lab. Repo: github.com/eth-sri/ConStat, Apache-2.0
- **接口**: `ConStat.test(...)` → p_value, delta, CI。纯黑盒，per-model 粒度。
- **⚠️ 关键 gap**: 不直接输出 per-item e_i。需推导或用 performance gap proxy。

## Baseline 深度评估 (2026-05-22)

### CyclicJudge ✅ 已实现
- 自实现 `/root/.../baselines/cyclic_judge.py` (58行)，round-robin + balanced(k=2) 两变体

### DCR (EMNLP 2025) — contamination-only correction baseline
- **Repo**: github.com/chengxuphd/dcr, Apache-2.0, ~300行核心代码
- **接口**: `DCRCalculator.calculate_dcr(s1,s2,s3,s4)` → DCR Factor [0,1], 确定性计算无需训练
- **输入**: 4 层污染分数 (Semantic/Information/Data/Label)，需从 G-MFRM 数据推导
- **⚠️ 不能替代 e_i**: per-model×benchmark 粒度，无 item-level 分解
- **适配**: 0.5-1天，主要在 s1-s4 映射逻辑。风险：映射公平性可能被 reviewer 质疑
- **定位**: "contamination-only correction" 对照，证明不管 judge bias 不够

### UDA (AAAI 2026) — unsupervised debiasing baseline
- **确认无代码**（anonymous repo 仍 403，作者 GitHub 无相关 repo）
- **方法**: MLP 动态调整 Elo K-factor + soft labels，最小化多 judge 间 dispersion
- **输入**: 多 judge pairwise judgments + response embeddings（6D+9 特征）
- **关键难点**: embedding 选择未明确、judge 自身 response 需额外生成、differentiable Elo
- **重实现**: ~330行, 2-3天。应在 exp-001 数据收集后开始（共用 pairwise judgment 数据）
- **定位**: aggregate-level debiasing 对照

### Preference Leakage (ICLR 2026) — aggregate leakage detection baseline
- **Repo**: github.com/David-Li0406/Preference-Leakage, 无 license, 55 stars
- **核心**: PLS = judge 偏向其 student 的 win-rate 差异，aggregate-level 指标
- **⚠️ 无 per-item signal**: PLS 是 model-pair 级别聚合，无法分解到 item
- **重实现**: PLS 公式 ~20行, 总 1.5天。核心算法 trivial。
- **定位**: "aggregate-level detection only" 对照，G-MFRM 提供 per-item 粒度的优势

### Baseline 总览
| Baseline | 代码 | 适配工作 | 定位 |
|----------|------|---------|------|
| CyclicJudge | ✅ 已完成 | 0 | naive round-robin |
| DCR | ✅ 可用 | 0.5-1天 | contamination-only |
| UDA | ❌ 需重实现 | 2-3天 | aggregate debiasing |
| Pref Leakage | ❌ 需重实现 | 1.5天 | aggregate detection |

## exp-001 Judge API 调研 (2026-05-21)

| DeepSeek V4 Pro | deepseek-v4-pro | $15.23 (促销→5/31) |
| Qwen3-235B | qwen3-235b-a22b | $7.20 (OpenRouter) |

### Open-Source Judges (4×RTX 6000 = 192GB)
- Llama-3.3-70B ✅ (AWQ 量化下载中)
- Qwen2.5-72B ✅
- Mistral-Medium 3.5 (128B FP8) ✅ 替代 Large 3

### 关键决策点
- DeepSeek 促销 5/31 到期
- 需 5 个 API key

**Step 3: 重新下载缺失分片**
先启用网络加速（AutoDL 环境）：
```bash
source /etc/network_turbo 2>/dev/null || true
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
```

用 huggingface-cli 只下载缺失文件：
```bash
nohup huggingface-cli download Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ \
  model-00001-of-00011.safetensors \
  --local-dir <模型目录> \
  --local-dir-use-symlinks False \
  > /tmp/qwen_shard1_download.log 2>&1 &
echo $!
```
记录 PID。

如果 huggingface-cli 不支持单文件下载，改用 wget/curl：

```bash
  -O <模型目录>/model-00001-of-00011.safetensors \
```

```bash
from modelscope.hub.file_download import model_file_download
model_file_download(
    model_id='Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ',
    file_path='model-00001-of-00011.safetensors',
    cache_dir='<模型目录>'
)
"
```

**Step 4: 轮询下载进度**
每 30-60 秒检查一次（用 ssh_read_only）：
```bash
ls -lh <模型目录>/model-00001-of-00011.safetensors 2>/dev/null || echo "NOT_YET"
ps -p <PID> -o pid= 2>/dev/null && echo "STILL_DOWNLOADING" || echo "DOWNLOAD_DONE"
tail -5 /tmp/qwen_shard1_download.log
```

**Step 5: 验证 11/11 分片齐全**

```bash
  --port 8002 \

  --max-model-len 4096 \
```
